## Aphid Abundance Data, Rothamsted

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| setup: true
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(mgcv)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

here::here()
```

```{r}
#|eval: false
#|
#Raw data read in - rothamsted files too big to store on github, so not included in repo.  Download from https://doi.org/10.23637/rothamsted.00000160.v1
rothamsted_files  <- list.files(here("data", "rothamsted"), full.names = TRUE)
rothamsted_coords <- read_csv(here("data", "rothamsted_coordinates.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

clean_trap <- function(x) stringr::str_squish(gsub("\u00a0", " ", as.character(x)))

rothamsted_data <- map_dfr(rothamsted_files, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE,
                                                        na = c("", "NA", "*"))) %>%
  mutate(Trap       = clean_trap(Trap),
         Date       = as.Date(Date),
         year       = year(Date),
         doy        = yday(Date),
         log_counts = log10(Total + 1))

rothamsted_coords <- rothamsted_coords %>% mutate(Trap = clean_trap(Trap))
stopifnot(length(setdiff(unique(rothamsted_data$Trap), rothamsted_coords$Trap)) == 0)

rothamsted_by_year <- rothamsted_data %>%
  group_by(year, Trap, Insect) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(rothamsted_data, here("data", "rothamsted_data.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

We can visualize the raw logged abundance date by date and species across sites.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

rothamsted_data <- read.csv(here("data/rothamsted_data.csv")) %>%
  mutate(Date       = as.Date(Date),
         year       = year(Date),
         doy        = yday(Date),
         log_counts = log10(Total + 1))

# Built first so a GAM failure below can't leave a stale copy
rothamsted_by_year <- rothamsted_data %>%
  group_by(year, Trap, Insect) %>%
  summarise(Total = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

species <- unique(rothamsted_data$Insect)

species_raw_plot <- function(spec, dat, k = 10) {
  spec_dat <- dat %>%
    dplyr::filter(Insect == spec, is.finite(Total), is.finite(doy)) %>%
    mutate(Trap = factor(Trap)) %>%
    droplevels()

  # Separate seasonal smooth per trap, pooled across years.
  # Tweedie (log link) because Total is a non-integer daily mean with zeros.
  spec_gam <- gam(Total ~ Trap + s(doy, by = Trap, k = k),
                  data = spec_dat, method = "REML", family = tw())

  # Prediction grid: each trap over its own observed doy range
  pred_grid <- spec_dat %>%
    group_by(Trap) %>%
    summarise(doy = list(seq(min(doy), max(doy), length.out = 200)),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::unnest(doy)

  pr <- predict(spec_gam, newdata = pred_grid, se.fit = TRUE, type = "link")

  # Link scale is natural log; convert to log10 to match the plotted data
  pred_grid <- pred_grid %>%
    mutate(fit = pr$fit / log(10),
           lwr = (pr$fit - 1.96 * pr$se.fit) / log(10),
           upr = (pr$fit + 1.96 * pr$se.fit) / log(10))

  ggplot(spec_dat, aes(x = doy, y = log10(Total + 1))) +
    geom_line(aes(color = year, group = year), alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_ribbon(data = pred_grid, aes(x = doy, ymin = lwr, ymax = upr),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "red", alpha = 0.15) +
    geom_line(data = pred_grid, aes(x = doy, y = fit),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 1) +
    facet_wrap(~ Trap) +
    labs(title = paste("Total Counts by Date and Trap:", spec),
         x = "Day of Year", y = "Log10 Counts", color = "Year") +
    theme_minimal() +
    scale_color_viridis_c() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 5))   # zooms without dropping ribbon values
}

# One species failing (e.g., a sparse trap) won't stop the rest
plots_list <- map(species, ~ species_raw_plot(.x, rothamsted_data)) %>% set_names(species)
names(plots_list)[map_lgl(plots_list, is.null)]   # species that failed, if any

plots_list[[1]]
plots_list[[2]]
plots_list[[3]]
```

We can also visualize year-by-year

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#summary table to check
summary_table <- rothamsted_by_year %>%
  group_by(Trap, year) 
#summary_table

ggplot(summary_table, aes(x = year, y = Total, color = Trap)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(title = "Total Counts by Year and Trap", x = "Year", y = "Total Counts") +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(.~Insect,nrow=3)
```

Where are these sites?

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

uk <- ne_countries(country="united kingdom", returnclass="sf",scale="medium")

rroth_sf <- rothamsted_by_year %>%
  group_by(Trap) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(rothamsted_coords, by = "Trap") %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = uk) +
  geom_sf(data = rroth_sf, aes(color = n_years), size = 3) +
  theme_minimal()

```
